description: This source file implements the management of bSTAMLD objects and related MLD (Multicast Listener Discovery) events. It includes functions for creating, updating, clearing, and responding to MLD events, as well as setting configuration parameters related to MLD behavior. The code interacts with external modules for object management, transaction handling, and event callbacks, and it defines a specific callback for MLD change events.
